method: Adjudicate only what the frozen source receipts establish: exact revision identity, byte/quote checks, declared source-only boundary, and conflicts or omissions explicitly surfaced by a lane. Do not convert a lane's self-check or another lane's existence into independent verification of a relation-level gold corpus.

adjudicated: Review A records 175 source relationships with zero missing committed sources and frozen quote/check output at this exact revision.
Review B is a separately authored source-only recovery at the same revision; its run declares no runtime execution and no peer comparison.
disagreements_or_unmerged_claims: No actor-to-actor relation comparison occurred. Relation-level overlap and differences remain unmerged rather than silently selected.
shared_omissions: Neither record establishes runtime execution, production behavior, or a general-completeness result.
cases.outcome: retain-both-raw-records; fresh isolated verifiers must replay source before any relation-level verdict

adjudicated: Review A records 171 source relationships, zero missing committed sources, and corrected the rejected historical end-line span before writing the frozen payload.
The revision remains distinct from main; no main-revision claim may stand in for this historical source check.
disagreements_or_unmerged_claims: Review B remains blocked on exact historical consumer/conditional-policy closure. Claims depending solely on that blocked frontier are unresolved and are not promoted.
shared_omissions: Neither lane establishes runtime execution, production behavior, or a general-completeness result.

adjudicated: Actor A's final source-only record preserves 201 traced steps, 25 authority contradictions, and five unknowns; those conflicts remain part of the proposed reference boundary.
Actor B's recovered source record explicitly states comparison_performed=false and adjudication_performed=false. It contributes its frozen evidence without confirming or overruling Actor A.
disagreements_or_unmerged_claims: No relation-level merge is performed because the paired actors did not compare each other and the proposed reference must not invent consensus.
shared_omissions: Target runtime conformance and unrelated downstream implementation behavior remain outside both source-only lanes.
cases.outcome: preserve-paired-records-and-contradictions; fresh isolated verifiers adjudicate relation-level differences

adjudicated: Handoff B freezes 291 records, 70 falsifiers, 587 quote bindings, zero manifest mismatches, and no remaining declared source dependency.
Handoff A closure-03 adds exact Git-object and SHA-256 evidence for the seven earlier missing committed sources at the same revision.
disagreements_or_unmerged_claims: The records are complementary source maps, not an actor-to-actor approval. Their relationship claims remain raw until fresh verification.
shared_omissions: The cited project settings contain PostToolUse context-rule handlers, but neither cited registry identifies the specific activity-stamping consumer declared by start-task. Global or user configuration and actual runtime delivery remain unknown.
cases.outcome: retain-complementary-source-records; fresh verifiers must preserve the activity-stamping runtime boundary
